newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower on weaker Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower on weaker Chicago.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower in all months on Thursday, reflecting price falls on the Chicago corn market overnight, trader said.
Prices were 30 to 120 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 40 yen at 14,220 yen per tonne.

Light selling orders from individual investors capped the topside of the market from the opening, traders said. But some investors produced technically driven buying in the afternoon, pushing up the market, they said.
"The trading is becoming quieter ahead of the Christmas and the New Year holidays," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.70 per bushel at 0710 GMT, against $2.71-1/4 at Wednesday's close.
The spot January of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.03 at 0710 GMT, against $7.04 at Wednesday's close.
